get.description:
The Zywave API search is implemented using [OData Version 4.0.1](https://www.odata.org/documentation/). Not all OData operations are available for the Zywave API platform at this time. Not all properties are filterable or sortable.
 The following properties that can be used when filtering and ordering the response.
  *  id
  *  accountId
  *  firstName
  *  lastName
  *  emailAddress
  *  isPrimaryContact
  *  isActive

 The following OData filter operations are supported by the Zywave API; each is accompanied by an example request.
 
 | Operation | Example Request | Returns |
 | ------- | -------- | -------- |
 | endswith   | endswith(lastName,'tact')    | Returns all account contacts where the last name ends with 'tact'    |
 | startswith   | startswith(lastName,'Cont')    | Returns all account contacts where the last name starts with 'Cont'    |
 | contains   | contains(lastName,'tact')    | Returns all account contacts where the name contains 'tact'    |
 | Equals   | accountId eq 2726742    | Returns all account contacts for the Zywave account with this unique id    |
 | Not Equals   | isActive ne false    | Returns all account contacts that are active    |
 | In   | lastName in ('Cont', 'act')    | Returns all account contacts where the last name is 'Cont' or 'act'    |
 | Not   | not startswith(lastName, 'Cont')    | Returns all account contacts where the last name does not start with 'Cont'    |
      
 The Zywave API also supports the And operation which will allow for multiple search criteria to be applied to a single request. For example, the following filter will return all active account contacts for the given account;
      
      
   *accountId eq 726742 and isActive ne false*
     
         
 The orderby operation also supports multiple levels of ordering. For example, to order the results by accountId then lastName the following can be used;
     
 
   *accountId asc, lastName asc*

parameters.description: The number of total records to skip before displaying the first result. In order to avoid an error please ensure that the $skip is dividable by the $top.

parameters.description: The total number of records returned in the response. In order to avoid an error please ensure that the $skip is dividable by the $top.

get.summary: Search for business and personal industry (SIC classification) information.
get.description:
The Zywave API search is implemented using [OData Version 4.0.1](https://www.odata.org/documentation/). Not all OData operations are available for the Zywave API platform at this time. Not all properties are filterable or sortable.
 The following properties can be used when filtering and ordering the response.
  *  id
  *  name
  *  code
  *  year
  *  length

 The following OData filter operations are supported by the Zywave API; each is accompanied by an example request.
 
 | Operation | Example Request | Returns |
 | ------- | -------- | -------- |
 | startswith   | startswith(Name,'Zyw')    | Returns all industries where the name starts with 'Zyw'    |
 | endswith | endswith(Name,'wave') | Returns all industries where the name ends with 'wave' |
 | contains   | contains(Name,'wave')    | Returns all industries where the name contains 'wave'    |
 | Equals   | Name eq 'Zywave'    | Returns all industries named Zywave    |
 | Not Equals   | Name ne 'Zywave'    | Returns all industries not named Zywave    |
 | Greater Than   | year gt 2012      | Returns all industries with a sicCode year greater than 2012    |
 | Greater Than or equal   | length ge 2    | Returns all industries with a sicCode length greater than or equal to 2    |
 | Less Than   | year lt 2012       | Returns all industries with a sicCode year less than or equal to 2012    |
 | Less Than or equal     | length le 22       | Returns all industries with a sicCode length less than or equal to 22    |
 | In   | Name in ('Zyw', 'ave')    | Returns all industries with the names 'Zyw' or 'ave'.    |
 | Not   | not startswith(Name,'Zyw')    | Returns all industries with a name that doesn't start with ‘Zyw’    |
 The Zywave API also supports the And operation which will allow for multiple search criteria to be applied to a single request. For example, the following filter will return all industries with a name that includes ‘I’ and a sicCode greater than 22
 
   *Contains(Name, 'I') and naicsCode gt 22*
 
 The orderby operation also supports multiple levels of ordering. For example, to order the results by name and then by sicCode, the following can be used;
 

   *Name asc, sicCode desc*
